controls.name: Invalid semantic transformation
controls.evidence: Transformations lacking typed primitive or required pre/post-conditions are rejected at schema validation

controls.name: Nonexistent target
controls.evidence: Candidate targeting symbols or modules absent from the semantic graph fails closed

controls.name: Violated precondition
controls.evidence: Candidate violating required entry state representation fails pre-materialization checks

controls.name: Violated postcondition
controls.evidence: Candidate failing to guarantee required output contract representation is rejected

controls.name: Representation mismatch
controls.evidence: Type or data-flow representation incompatibilities across coupled regions trigger rejection

controls.name: Invariant violation
controls.evidence: Materialized candidate failing whole-program regression tests fails clean-room verification

controls.name: Gold leakage
controls.evidence: Static scanner detects and rejects hardcoded Pratt binding power constants or CORS regexes

controls.name: Unauthorized mutation
controls.evidence: Authority firewall rejects any materialization touching files outside the allowed mutation scope

controls.name: Semantic candidate passes locally but fails globally
controls.evidence: Materialized candidate passing local unit checks but violating whole-program regression is rejected

controls.name: Nondeterministic materialization
controls.evidence: Canonical sorting of edits and deterministic AST patch application guarantees byte-identical patch digests
